import openpyxl

    if rows:

        headers = [c["value"] for c in rows[0]]
        col_widths = [max(len(h), 8) for h in headers]
        # Compute col widths across all rows
        for row in rows:

        # Print data rows
        for row in rows[1:]:
            vals = [c["value"] for c in row]
            line = " | ".join(v.ljust(col_widths[i]) for i, v in enumerate(vals))

# Also save as JSON for structured access
with open("CUGA_generalist_agent/.cuga/env/testbed/data/order_summary_extracted.json", "w") as f:

print("\\nFiles saved successfully.")
print("\\n--- Extracted Content ---")
print(output_text)
